command:
set -eo pipefail
cd /tmp
echo "== seqkit on the complete SRR062634 run: the same reads bwa aligns and fastp filters =="
df -m /tmp | awk 'NR==2{print "tmpfs_total_mb "$2}'
( MAX=0; while :; do U=$(df -m /tmp | awk 'NR==2{print $3}')
    [ "$U" -gt "$MAX" ] && { MAX=$U; echo "$MAX" > /tmp/.peak; }; sleep 2; done ) & SAMPLER=$!

T0=$(date +%s)
echo "== seqkit stats =="
seqkit stats -T -j 8 SRR062634_1.filt.fastq.gz SRR062634_2.filt.fastq.gz > stats.tsv
cat stats.tsv
echo "== seqkit fq2fa, both mates =="
seqkit fq2fa -j 8 SRR062634_1.filt.fastq.gz -o r1.fa.gz
seqkit fq2fa -j 8 SRR062634_2.filt.fastq.gz -o r2.fa.gz
seqkit stats -T -j 8 r1.fa.gz r2.fa.gz > fa_stats.tsv
cat fa_stats.tsv
T1=$(date +%s); WALL=$(( T1 - T0 ))
kill "$SAMPLER" 2>/dev/null || true
PEAK=$(cat /tmp/.peak 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
# Do NOT rm the staged reads: sticky /tmp, stage-in ran as the instance user, so the container
# gets EPERM -- which `rm -f` does not suppress and which would kill the task under set -e.

# -T gives a plain tab table: 1 file 2 format 3 type 4 num_seqs 5 sum_len 6 min_len 7 avg_len 8 max_len
F() { awk -F'\t' -v r="$1" -v c="$2" 'NR==r{print $c}' "$3"; }
R1N=$(F 2 4 stats.tsv); R1L=$(F 2 5 stats.tsv)
R2N=$(F 3 4 stats.tsv); R2L=$(F 3 5 stats.tsv)
MIN=$(F 2 6 stats.tsv);  MAX=$(F 2 8 stats.tsv)
A1N=$(F 2 4 fa_stats.tsv); A1L=$(F 2 5 fa_stats.tsv)
A2N=$(F 3 4 fa_stats.tsv); A2L=$(F 3 5 fa_stats.tsv)
FMT=$(F 2 2 fa_stats.tsv)
# 4.8e9 bases overflows awk's %d (int32 -> clamps at 2147483647), so every sum uses %.0f.
TOTN=$(awk -v a="$R1N" -v b="$R2N" 'BEGIN{printf "%.0f", a+b}')
TOTL=$(awk -v a="$R1L" -v b="$R2L" 'BEGIN{printf "%.0f", a+b}')
FAN=$(awk -v a="$A1N" -v b="$A2N" 'BEGIN{printf "%.0f", a+b}')
FAL=$(awk -v a="$A1L" -v b="$A2L" 'BEGIN{printf "%.0f", a+b}')

{
  echo "r1_num_seqs      $R1N   want 24148993"
  echo "r2_num_seqs      $R2N   want == r1 (mates paired)"
  echo "total_num_seqs   $TOTN   want exactly 48297986"
  echo "                            == bwa primary records (48817006 - 519020 suppl.)"
  echo "                            == fastp before_filtering.total_reads"
  echo "total_sum_len    $TOTL   want exactly 4829798600  == fastp total_bases"
  echo "read_len         min=$MIN max=$MAX   want 100/100 (uniform)"
  echo "fa_format        $FMT   want FASTA"
  echo "fa_num_seqs      $FAN   want == total_num_seqs  [conversion conserves records]"
  echo "fa_sum_len       $FAL   want == total_sum_len    [conversion conserves bases]"
  echo "wall_s           $WALL"
  echo "tmpfs_peak_used_mb $PEAK"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt
test "$R1N"  -eq 24148993
test "$R2N"  -eq "$R1N"
test "$TOTN" = '48297986'
test "$TOTL" = '4829798600'
test "$MIN"  -eq 100
test "$MAX"  -eq 100
test "$FMT"  = 'FASTA'
test "$FAN"  = "$TOTN"
test "$FAL"  = "$TOTL"
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
